welcome.title: Welcome to Utah
welcome.description: Utahraptor is a Bluefin-derived GNOME workstation built on Fedora Hummingbird.

features.title: Offline installation
features.description: This ISO carries the Utah image and its default Flatpaks, so installation does not need a network connection.

completed.title: Utah is installed
completed.description: Restart your computer to begin using Utah.
